writeup.headline: Megacaps Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Chip Earnings Spook Investors Even With Beats. The big swing: megacaps rallied early, then turned around after 9:59 AM and are now lower on the day — The New York Times points to “Stock Markets Slip as Nvidia and A.I. Stocks Erase Some of Monday’s Rally”. The AI names are down and the average stock is up: money is rotating out of the AI giants into the rest of the market. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Megacaps gave back their early rally
themes.detail: Down 0.8% at 9:59 AM, now -2.4%; hardest hit since: Nvidia, Tesla. In the news: “Stock Markets Slip as Nvidia and A.I. Stocks Erase Some of Monday’s Rally” (The New York Times).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 9:31 AM, high at 10:04 AM; -0.2% since the open.

themes.headline: Chip Earnings Spook Investors Even With Beats
themes.detail: Analog Devices -18.5%, Nvidia -8.6%, News +1.0% on the day.

themes.headline: Health Care leads, Technology lags
